subject: bgiteration: avoid missing key check for multi/exec commands (#5205)
reason: The fix prevents an assertion crash (serverAssert(wasAdded) in bgiteration.c) that can only be reached through a non-consistent background iterator: the buggy loop is gated by `if (!(it->iteration_flags & BGITERATOR_FLAG_CONSISTENT))`. In this build the only live-server code that creates a background iterator is forklessSaveToDisk(), which uses BGITERATOR_CONSISTENCY_START (a consistent iterator) and so skips that branch entirely; bgIteratorCreateSlotsIter (the eventual-consistency slot-migration iterator) has no production caller, replication full sync is always fork-based, and CONSISTENCY_EV
